name: Opening titles
description: A letterboxed horizon fades up from black and pans in three parallax layers under a low warm sun, like the first part of a PC demo.
choices: Letterbox bars, a palette fade and a slow sideways pan carry the opening-titles grammar into a single frame
Steel-blue VGA ranges are pulled toward the brand navy; one warm sun is the only accent
motion: Fades up from black once, then the ridges pan slowly in parallax and the stars twinkle.
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
